captions: Open End Point Explorer and check the total records in scope.
Chart bars summarise the inventory; the table shows matching records.
scenes.title: Choose the records to examine

captions: Click a chart bar to filter the records, then open a column filter.
Select an exact value from the column menu to narrow the result further.
scenes.title: Narrow the results

captions: Check the filter chips. Remove a chip or choose Clear all filters.
Use the search box to find a name, identifier or other recorded value.
scenes.title: Check the filters you have applied

captions: Select a linked name to inspect its CMDB record, then close the panel.
Export Excel downloads every matching record, across all table pages.
scenes.title: Open details or download the records

captureMethod: Playwright screencast of the guide-launched practice lab; caption, pointer and focus overlays only.
